## Tronador GitHub Pages generation
Improve the documentation generation process by using Tronador to create GitHub Pages from the `docs` folder. Update `docs` folder with the latest documentation, and then generate the corresponding GitHub Pages.
The generated pages will be placed in the `docs-pages` folder, ensuring that the documentation is easily accessible and well-organized.
Use Jekyll to build the GitHub Pages into the `docs-pages` folder, and then push the changes to the `gh-pages` branch of the repository. This will ensure that the latest documentation is always available on GitHub Pages.
Use the cloudopsworks/main-website and https://cloudopsworks.co as source to configure Jekyll theme.
